title: pastinaca cyclocarpa
intro: Pastinaca cyclocarpa, commonly known as wild carrot or pastinaca, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health, alleviate respiratory issues, and as a diuretic. The health benefits of Pastinaca cyclocarpa are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe digestive discomfort, reduce inflammation, and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
